name: Heat-set threaded insert for plastics
standard: (no ISO standard; tapered knurled heat-set inserts for 3D prints)
source: ruthex RX-M tapered heat-set inserts: outer diameter OD (D1), length l and recommended hole diameter (D3), as listed by 3DJake for the ruthex M2..M8 inserts (2026-11). The vendor gives no hole depth; hole_depth = l + 1 mm (guideline, so the insert does not bottom out).
